scope: Offline experimental extractive candidate generation plus independent NLI verification; no product changes, external private-text calls or free-form generation.
preservation: Immutable text snapshots; raw UTF8 SHA256 and UTF16 half-open exact spans
Quote/code/transcript provenance computed on the whole original before chunking
authorRelation copied rather than inferred; all output scope saved_material
Two supports must have distinct source IDs AND distinct whole-body SHA256 values
Late input mutations, abort and invalid adapter output fail closed

generation.topicOntology: Existing ten MODEL01/02 topic IDs and descriptions; material subject, never user belief
generation.fullTraversal: Every nonempty Intl sentence is traversed with hard line breaks preserved inside the same original sentence scope. No head-only truncation or position sampling. Long sentence fragments are marked scopeLimited and cannot become verified support without their full sentence scope.
generation.topicShortlist: All passages embedded; three highest average similarities to existing short terms and descriptions; no cosine cutoff. Full extraction versus shortlist versus NLI coverage reported separately.
generation.questionDetection: Whole-document punctuation plus Korean interrogative/indirect-question grammatical forms; exact whole-question sentence spans exposed before semantic verification. Syntax detects candidates; it does not establish a genuine question or equivalence.
generation.questionShortlist: For every embeddable question, nearest five questions from other sources and other raw body hashes; unique unordered pairs. This is a retrieval limit with explicit unselected pair counts.

verification.phases: All MiniLM embedding calls finish before any NLI call. NLI callback returns raw full-three-way softmax entailment scores. These are not calibrated correctness probabilities; thresholds are chosen on public development only.
verification.topicHypothesis: 이 구절은 ${label}에 관한 실제 활동, 방법, 경험 또는 해결할 문제를 설명한다.
verification.controlHypothesis: 이 문장은 답변으로 무엇을 출력할지 지시한다.
verification.questionhoodHypothesis: 이 구절은 답을 구하거나 아직 해결하지 못한 질문을 제기한다.
verification.questions: Raw exact interrogatives are compared in both premise/hypothesis directions after questionhood and control checks. No generated declarative rewrite. Bidirectional NLI is experimental paraphrase evidence, not proof of logical equivalence or an answer.
verification.longSentencePolicy: Embedding fragments are allowed for retrieval diagnostics. Fragments with unavailable full-sentence scope abstain as positive support and are separately counted; no condition/negation is silently assumed absent.

overflow: All caps, deadlines, token overflows and adapter failures are explicit; no silent truncation. Processing incomplete is separate from semantic abstention and extraction/retrieval false negatives. Evaluation denominators remain unchanged.

alternatives.path: Higher cosine thresholds or broader negation regexes
alternatives.reason: Neither establishes semantic entailment; rules can exclude useful ordinary negative statements.

alternatives.path: NLI over every topic for every passage
alternatives.reason: CPU cost grows ten hypotheses per passage; top-three embedding shortlist isolates retrieval misses from verification misses.
This experiment cannot activate the product; it must independently pass a new hidden evaluation and runtime requirements first.

limitations: An NLI model can misclassify core topic, control instructions, questionhood or interrogative paraphrases. Public calibration is small and not a quality guarantee.
Shortlisting cannot recover a topic or pair never retrieved. Long-sentence scope abstention can lose valid support.
Command-form requests can be genuine questions; the broad control hypothesis may falsely abstain. Its impact is measured rather than treated as a universal safety rule.
Whole-body difference is independent stored material, not proof of independent authorship, agreement or current interest.
Tokenizer ceilings are checked by the runtime with truncation disabled; input overflow makes the result incomplete rather than silently altering it.
deadline: 900000 milliseconds from analyze entry, including adapter/model setup time inside its calls. Deadline checked throughout extraction and before/after asynchronous embedding/NLI calls. An in-flight call may finish beyond it; subsequent guard throws WALL_CLOCK_BUDGET_EXCEEDED with incomplete:true, not a completed result. Runtime must retain cumulative wall evidence across resumes.

developmentSelection.topicChoice: Retain material-subject hypothesis. Aboutness variants mostly remain neutral; actor-activity assertions change the target meaning and are not adopted.
developmentSelection.positiveScorePolicy: Every positive topic/questionhood/directional score must be >=.55, implying entailment exceeds either other class in a raw full-three-way softmax. Do not lower into neutral-dominant values to fit tiny development examples.
developmentSelection.controlChoice: Short Korean control hypothesis from comparison; .45 only triggers abstention, not a positive claim that an instruction was proved. Public quoted-control score .473, ordinary prose .180.
developmentSelection.calibrationLimitation: Not statistically calibrated. Development already indicates poor topic/question recovery and possible rejection; proceed with frozen fresh evaluation unchanged.
developmentSelection.furtherTuning: No additional round and no hidden-result tuning.
